title: Expectation against a linear form
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $a$ assign a real coefficient to each coordinate. The uniform expectation of $f(x)$ times the linear form $sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$ equals $sum_{i=1}^n a_i\widehat f(\{i\})$, where $\widehat f(\{i\})$ is the uniform expectation of $f(x)x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is any real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$a$ is any real-valued coordinate coefficient function
